title: Pixel 2XL + G5 randomly disconnecting
symptom: Using xDrip with a new G5 transmitter on a Pixel 2 XL, the connection works for 2-16 hours then xDrip stops getting data and fails to connect, hanging on 'waiting to connect'. Restarting the collector does not fix it; only a full phone reboot and collector restart restores function. This happens 1-3 times per day.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer suggests the Pixel 2 XL has known Bluetooth issues and recommends contacting Google for a replacement, but no specific cause is confirmed.
fix: No fix is provided. The maintainer suggests contacting Google for a replacement phone if under warranty, but no actionable fix is given.
evidence_quote: Unfortunately, the Pixel 2 XL seems to be having quite a lot of issues with Bluetooth
